issues.description: The problem statement requires selecting municipalities with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution query uses thresholds of 10,000 (einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This numeric mismatch will produce incorrect results and confuse students implementing or validating the query.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the numeric thresholds in the solution (and template/example) to match the problem statement: use einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000. Update any tests or example queries to use 100000 instead of 10000 so students are evaluated against the intended requirement.
